repeatability.measurement: Joint feedback + configured FK, including explicitly marked motor-based zero-band estimates when enabled; not external 3D metrology
repeatability.acceptance: Maximum pairwise distance between repeated settled endpoints

performance.measurement: Motion curves: raw CAN output feedback + FK; zero-report transitions can inflate derivatives. Stop metrics: marked API motor-based reconstruction; raw_output_* retains raw CAN results.
performance.speed_estimator: 55 ms, cubic Savitzky-Golay derivative of FK positions from 200 Hz interpolated output angles
performance.endpoint_measurement: API output feedback with marked motor-based estimates inside firmware zero band; 1 mrad motor resolution, not external 3D metrology
performance.position_settle_observation: First sample after the last >1 mm target-position error; must remain within 1 mm until recording ends. Not a velocity or external metrology criterion.
